description: This file manages in-app purchases, subscription status, and email verification dialogs for the Notesnook mobile app, including functions for loading products, verifying receipts, and handling user subscription state.

methods.name: setPremiumStatus
methods.description: Sets the user's premium status based on subscription data and updates user store.

methods.name: loadProductsAndSubs
methods.description: Loads available subscription and product data from the app store.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Checks if the current user has an active non-free subscription plan.

methods.name: showVerifyEmailDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to verify user's email and resend verification link.
